event: The confirmation prompt needs a diff command, but a target never committed has no commit to diff against, and its reviewed copy can only live in .canon/, which the reviewer prompt forbids reading; the D001 and P001 confirmations each needed an ad-hoc exception line.
suggestion: Name the reviewed copy (.canon/canon-blind-review/<topic>/before.md) in the skill and let the confirmation prompt allow reading exactly that file, or have the gate commit an uncommitted target before the first round.

event: Step 1 says canon.py check warns that the revision is not reviewed until step 5, but check warns only for a doc past its gate (an accepted or active design, an accepted or in-progress plan), so a new draft gets no such warning (canon.py, past_gate in the doc check).
suggestion: Say the warning appears only for a revision of a doc past its gate, or have check also warn for a draft whose reviewed is below revision.

event: Nothing says what to do with a first-round reviewer whose run stops before it reports (interrupted, timed out, failed); resuming is described only for the confirmation round, so the agent launched a new reviewer twice, starting the review over, until the user said to resume the stalled one.
suggestion: In the canon workflow's Subagents section, which covers reviewers and workers: a subagent whose run stops before it reports is resumed by its id and asked to finish; a new one replaces it only when it cannot be resumed.

event: Recurrence of the 2026-10-15 entry: P002, a new plan, was untracked through its gate, so both confirmation prompts said no diff could be run and sent the reviewers to reread the whole 250-line target, and no copy of the reviewed version existed to diff against (.canon/canon-blind-review/P002/*-confirm-prompt.md).
suggestion: Have the gate save the reviewed copy as .canon/canon-blind-review/<topic>/before.md before the first round and give the confirmation `git diff --no-index` against it, allowing the reviewer to read that one file.

event: P002's S1 worker put its benchmark scratch under /tmp/canon-s1-bench/. The canon skill's Layout puts a canon skill's temporary files in .canon/<skill>/<topic>/, but the worker prompt leads only to the plan, the design sections, canon-tdd and canon-grill, none of which says where scratch goes.
suggestion:
Have the worker prompt name .canon/canon-implement/

/ for the slice's scratch files, or have canon-tdd point to the canon skill's rule for temporary files.

event: Two reviewers wrote files although their prompts said 'Do not modify any file': D000's gate reviewer created .tmp/.tmp_canon_view.py and P002's Spec code reviewer created .canon_review_diff_unused in the repo root, each to read long command output, and the second could not delete its file. The prompts name no place for scratch output, while the project's AGENTS.md sends temporary files to .tmp/.
suggestion: Have the reviewer prompts say where scratch output may go (the project's temporary directory, else nowhere) and that no other file may change, or that command output is read directly.

event: Recurrence of the 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-23 entries: D000 was untracked through its gate, so the session rebuilt the reviewed version by hand in .tmp/D000-reviewed.md to give the confirmation prompt a `git diff --no-index` command (.canon/canon-blind-review/D000/same-model-confirm-prompt.md).
suggestion: Have the gate save the reviewed copy of an untracked target before the author revises it, e.g. .canon/canon-blind-review/<topic>/reviewed.md, and let the confirmation prompt diff against it.

event: check warned that D005 still held template guidance because the design quoted canon's own index markers, `<!-- canon:index:start -->`, in inline code and in a fenced example; the guidance check matches `<!-- canon:` anywhere in a doc, so the design had to name the markers as the HTML comments `canon:index:start` and `canon:index:end`, as D004 already does for the canon block.
suggestion: Have the guidance check skip inline code and fenced code blocks, or match only the comments the templates hold.

event: The topic directory is the doc id, reused by every revision's gate, so saving D001 r8's same-model.md overwrote r7's result from 2026-10-22; earlier rounds survived only because a session had moved them into r1/ and r6/ by hand, and D000's r1 round had to be moved into r1/ before its r2 gate.
suggestion: Name the topic by revision, such as D001-r8, or say to move the previous round's files into r<N>/ before a new first round.

event: Recurrence of the 2026-10-30 entry: D004 r4's text quoted a `<!-- canon: ... -->` comment in inline code, and check failed with ERROR 'template guidance left in the doc' until the sentence was reworded.
suggestion: Ignore guidance markers inside inline code and fenced blocks when looking for leftover template guidance.
